target.title: fix(ui): keep Workboard detail drawer actions in parity
target.body:
Closes #99957.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Workboard users could open a card detail drawer but lose access to the card-management actions that are available on compact cards, including edit, archive/unarchive, status move, open session, stop when active, and delete.

The crowded-column portion of the original report is already covered by existing mainline behavior; this PR keeps the remaining drawer action-parity fix separate from the optional board-name filter request.

## Why This Change Was Made

The compact card and detail drawer now share the same Workboard action state and button helpers, so mutation guards stay aligned instead of having a drawer-only copy that can drift. The drawer keeps the existing start controls, uses full-width status movement, and keeps read-only/archived/busy/dispatch states behind the same guards as compact cards.

Compared with the other open candidates for #99957, this PR avoids unrelated gateway fixture churn from #100319 and keeps the visible drawer actions more discoverable than icon-only drawer controls while adding mocked Gateway browser E2E proof similar to #100838.

## User Impact

Users can manage a Workboard card directly from the expanded detail drawer without closing it and returning to the compact card. Read-only users still get inspection/open-session behavior without mutation controls.

## Evidence

Head SHA: `490c2e0ef5`.

- `git diff --check` - passed.
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxlint --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.core.json ui/src/pages/workboard/view.ts ui/src/pages/workboard/view.test.ts ui/src/pages/workboard/workboard.e2e.test.ts` - passed.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/pages/workboard/view.test.ts` - passed: 1 file, 69 tests.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.ui-e2e.config.ts --configLoader runner ui/src/pages/workboard/workboard.e2e.test.ts` - passed: 1 file, 2 tests.
- The mocked Gateway E2E now opens the Workboard detail drawer and asserts the detail action area shows status move, Open session, Edit card, Archive card, and Delete card controls; it also asserts Stop session is absent for an inactive linked session and that read-only detail drawers hide mutation controls.
- Browser proof artifact: https://gist.github.com/momothemage/f417b69271f0a57374b6a4ba517a58cf contains `05-detail-actions.svg` and `proof-manifest.json`, showing the mocked Control UI Workboard detail drawer with Edit card, Archive card, status move, Open session, and Delete card visible.

Related PR state reviewed:

- #100319 targets the same issue but still carries a needs-proof review state and includes an unrelated gateway performance fixture change.
- #100838 targets the same issue and has screenshot/E2E proof; this PR now has the same kind of mocked Gateway E2E coverage while keeping the code path narrow and the drawer controls text-visible.
